title: Dental PPO Plans Computation of a Reprocessed Prior-Level Line
content:
For the Dental PPO Plans, the plan payment and patient share of a paid line reprocessed after it was paid at the coinsurance of the plan held before an upgrade (a reprocessed prior-level line) are figured as set out in the clauses below.

**(1) Benefit year.** A corrected prior-level decision is booked to the benefit year its date of service falls in (the calendar year of that date), whatever benefit year the replaced decision was booked to, and the deductible and annual-maximum counts it uses are those of that benefit year.

**(2) Allowance and coinsurance.** The payment is figured on the line's allowed amount. The coinsurance is the plan's in-network percentage for the line's service class.

**(3) Waiting period from the plan change.** The line is payable at the plan's level only when its date of service is at least its waiting period counted in whole calendar months from the plan change date. A month counts as whole when the day of the month of the date of service is not earlier than that of the plan change date, which always falls on the first of a month. The waiting period is the one for the line's service class that applies to the enrollment: the plan's individual waiting period for individual and individual exchange enrollments, its late-entrant waiting period for group enrollments of a late entrant, and none for other group enrollments or for preventive services. Until then the line is figured at the coinsurance percentage recorded on the decision it replaces.

**(4) Deductible.** The plan's individual deductible less the person's deductible postings net of deductible reversals for the line's benefit year, after any posting the replaced decision made to that benefit year is backed out; never below zero and never more than the allowance the payment is figured on. A preventive-class line on a plan that waives the preventive deductible, or any line on a plan whose individual deductible is 0.00, takes none. Because every Cascade plan's family deductible maximum is three times its individual deductible, on an account with no more than three enrolled persons the family limit never falls below the person's own remaining deductible, so the line counts only the person's own deductible postings.

**(5) Normal benefit.** The allowance less the deductible taken, times the coinsurance, rounded to the cent with a half cent rounded up; the plan payment and patient share are rounded to the cent the same way.

**(6) Annual maximum.** The plan payment is never more than the person's remaining annual maximum for the line's benefit year: the plan's annual maximum less the person's maximum postings net of maximum reversals for that benefit year, after any posting the replaced decision made to that benefit year is backed out. For a person receiving the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment (an individual exchange enrollment and a date of service before the person's pediatric age-limit birthday) no annual maximum applies.

**(7) Patient share.** The billed amount less the plan payment for a line from an out-of-network practice, and the allowed amount less the plan payment otherwise, never below zero.

**(8) Order.** The waiting-period test comes first and decides whether the plan's coinsurance or the replaced decision's applies; the allowance and coinsurance then give the normal benefit; the annual-maximum ceiling gives the plan payment; the patient share is figured last from the plan payment, its zero floor last.

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)
A major-class crown dated 14 March, in network, on a plan changed on 1 January to one whose major waiting period is 12 months; the replaced decision recorded coinsurance of 50 percent and posted 25.00 to the deductible and 297.65 to the annual maximum of that same year. Allowed amount 620.30. For the year: deductible postings 25.00 (all from the replaced decision), maximum postings 297.65 (all from it); individual deductible 25.00; annual maximum 2500.00; in-network major coinsurance 60 percent.
- Whole months from 1 January to 14 March: 2, under 12, so the replaced decision's 50 percent applies.
- Deductible: 25.00 less (25.00 less the backed-out 25.00), which is 25.00.
- Normal benefit: 620.30 less 25.00 is 595.30; times 50 percent is 297.65.
- Remaining maximum: 2500.00 less 0.00; the plan payment is 297.65; the patient share is 620.30 less 297.65, which is 322.65.
